Apple Arcade adds new games to its ad-free, in-app purchase-free library every month. According to Apple's latest announcement, five new games will be released next month.

Apple Arcade October New Additions Include Pusheen the Cat Game, Terraria+ and More

The App Store offers a vast selection of games, but many are plagued by ads or endless in-app purchases to unlock content.

Apple Arcade, on the other hand, is a carefully curated collection featuring over 200 premium games with absolutely no ads or in-app purchases.

New games are added every month, and Apple has just announced that five new titles will launch on October 1st.

  • Pusheen's Place: "Build a cozy Pusheen paradise and collect over 100 adorable little cats"
  • River City Survivors: "An explosive survivors-like action game that throws players wave after wave into zombie mayhem"
  • Terraria+: "A sandbox action-adventure game where players can fight, explore, and build their way to expanding their own world"
  • Touchgrind BMX 2+: "A physics-driven BMX stunt game with unique two-finger controls that make every trick feel incredibly realistic"
  • 4 Pics 1 Word+: "A wildly popular puzzle game that has stumped and delighted over 400 million players worldwide"

All titles marked with a '+' are special Arcade versions of existing App Store games, stripped of ads and in-app purchases. Pusheen's Place and River City Survivors, however, are entirely new games and are not currently available on the App Store.

Are you an Apple Arcade subscriber? Which games are your favorites? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.

Apple Arcade costs $6.99 per month, or it can be bundled through an Apple One subscription. Subscribers get unlimited access to over 200 premium games with no ads and no in-app purchases.
